sources.title: lightware-dev/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3-bf16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The weights are identical to the upstream model apart from the fp32 → bf16 conversion. Restoring from this checkpoint loads straight onto a CUDA GPU without ever materialising an fp32 copy, which is faster to start (13 s vs ~22 s) and roughly halves peak load-time VRAM (1.3 GB).

sources.title: Parakeet 0.6b TDT collection | NVIDIA NGC
sources.snippet: This collection offers two Parakeet TDT 0.6B variants: v2 (English only) and v3 (25 European languages). Both are 600-million-parameter models with native punctuation, capitalization, and accurate word-level timestamp prediction.
